description: Returns the actual screenshot image from a check, so you can SEE the monitored page rather than infer it from a diff percentage. view: 'current' (the page as of this check), 'previous' (the page before it), or 'diff' (the two composited with changes highlighted). Pass checkId 'latest' to see the current state of a monitor without looking up a check id first. Use this to answer 'what does the page look like now?', to judge whether a reported change actually matters, and to work out the right CSS selector for an action or extractor by looking at the layout.

checkId.description: Check id (from get_check_history), or 'latest' for the most recent completed check. Defaults to 'latest'.

maxHeight.description: Height bound, default 3000, max 4000. Full-page captures are very tall, so this is what usually decides the scale.

maxWidth.description: Longest width to scale to, default 1200, max 4000

view.description: Which image: 'current' (default), 'previous', or 'diff' with changes highlighted

name: view_check_screenshot
title: View a check screenshot
